interdum

adverb

sometimes, now and then

In this lexicon

  • sometimes

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 2.64: sed interdum etiam frūctuōsum; Mor. 28: interdum fessae succēdit laeva sorōrī; Traupman 382

Examples

  • est enim nōn modo līberāle paulum nōn numquam dē suō jūre dēcēdere, sed interdum etiam frūctuōsum

    for to give up a little of your rights now and then is not only generous but sometimes even profitableCic. Off. 2.64
